mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_feature_flag (flag_key, enabled, note, operator, update_time) VALUES (#{flagKey}, #{enabled}, #{note}, #{operator}, #{updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), note = VALUES(note), operator = VALUES(operator), update_time = VALUES(update_time)

INSERT INTO mcp_feature_flag (flag_key, enabled, note, operator, update_time) VALUES (#{flagKey}, #{enabled}, #{note}, #{operator}, #{updateTime}) ON CONFLICT (flag_key) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, note = EXCLUDED.note, operator = EXCLUDED.operator, update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time
mapper.sql: id, flag_key, enabled, note, operator, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mcp_feature_flag ORDER BY flag_key ASC
